messages:
sana: Quick heads-up — onboarding magnet-16b quant4x for longcontext tests; hitting token duplication after ~4k crossing a shard boundary.

evan: :eyes: paste minimal repro and logs?

sana: repro (staging-dedicated-gpu-2):
```bash
./run_infer --model magnet-16b-quant4x --prompt-file tests/longspan/anchor_8k.txt --max-tokens 2048 --kv-mode rollforward
```

sana: stderr snippet (trimmed):
[2025-06-12T09:15:03Z] kv-rollforward: shard=2 idx=4095 -> mapped_idx=0
[2025-06-12T09:15:03Z] kv-checksum: expected=0x7a3f4c got=0x7a3f4c
[2025-06-12T09:15:04Z] generate: token=1345 text="the"
[2025-06-12T09:15:04Z] generate: token=1345 text="the"  <-- dup starts here

evan: checksum match but dup — suggests remap reused slot without populating KV vectors or per-head zeros. did float32 repro?

sana: float32 run clean. quant4x shows dup + small next-token prob skew.

marc: can you dump kcache keys around remap?

sana: key dump (key_idx:hex):
4094: a1b2c3...
4095: deadbe...
0: a1b2c3...  <-- key at 0 matches 4094 after remap
1: 000000...  <-- zeroed slot for some heads

sana: looks like remap moved 4095->0 but slot 0 has zeroed head-blocks. may cause attention to fall back and repeat.

ops-bot: @sana created ticket RW-3917 "quant4x rollforward partial-kv-zeroing causes token duplication"

marc: hypothesis: quant memcpy packed stride skips a head-block when index wraps. int/float unpack path masks it, so float32 unaffected. evan, can you run MEMCPY_CHECK=1 debug?

evan: running with MEMCPY_CHECK, will try smaller longprefill to repro faster. ETA ~30m.

sana: temporary workaround: KV_ROLLFORWARD_STRICT=1 (forces full re-populate) — perf hit ~6% but removes dup on staging.

marc: add CI regression: quant4x longprefill -> continue, assert no repeated ngram >3 across shard boundary and record per-head zero-count.

ci-bot: build 2025.06.12-quant4x-debug queued (owner: evan).

evan: MEMCPY_CHECK flagged head-block 3 on shard 2 skipped during remap (copy_len=0). stack points to quant_kv_remap_packed() in kvcache_packed.c:427.

sana: I'll open PR with bound check and unit test simulating odd stride counts; will add telemetry metric per-head zero-count.

marc: actions: 1) patch remap memcpy guard (sana), 2) CI regression (marc), 3) telemetry per-head zero-count (sana), 4) cross-quant comparison magnet-16b & magnet-7b (evan). Aim to ship staging fix by EOD if canary passes.

sana: noted, leaving STRICT=1 until validated. thanks all :thumbsup:

ops-bot: ticket RW-3917 updated: status=investigating, linked PR=NONE, labels=quant,kv,rollforward

evan: initial canary failure rate with strict=0 ~4/20 runs; with strict=1 it's 0/20. will post debug logs when build finishes."
